news.t: PS Medico build 31 (19 Nov 2026): the live data channel - published price checks now reach every copy automatically when it is opened with internet (no new file to share), plus a Check for data updates now button in the builder admin and a price-data status line. Prices set or approved on a device are never overwritten.
